situation (example wording): "Robberies by weapon in Texas in 2024", any breakdown by weapon, and a single-weapon question such as "robberies with a handgun".
what the app does today: The weapon breakdown groups on the raw weapon code, so the automatic codes are their own rows: 11A "Firearm (Automatic)", 12A "Handgun (Automatic)", 13A "Rifle (Automatic)" (and 14A, 15A). A single-code filter such as handgun matches 12 only. The "firearm" filter already includes all ten codes.
proposed behavior: A weapon recorded with the automatic flag counts in the same row as the plain code: 12A in Handgun, 11A in Firearm (type not stated), 13A in Rifle. The flag is not a separate row. The same applies to 14A in Shotgun and 15A in Other Firearm (not named on the card; same rule). A single-weapon filter (handgun, rifle) includes its automatic code. An offense with both the plain and the automatic code counts once in that row.
exact default or choices offered: Rows: Firearm (type not stated) = 11 + 11A; Handgun = 12 + 12A; Rifle = 13 + 13A; Shotgun = 14 + 14A; Other Firearm = 15 + 15A. No "(Automatic)" rows.
why: Jeff 2026-11-23 (card answer, through the coordinator): yes, same row. The independent checker matches the engine on QL-nibrs-ea524d684d when the flag folds into the plain row. SHR already combines 12 and 12A (shr.ts).
